title: Is Dark Energy Weakening? 68% of the Universe Is a Mystery
description:
About 68% of the universe is dark energy, the unknown something that is speeding up the expansion of space, discovered in 1998 using distant exploding stars. Now the DESI survey, which mapped millions of galaxies, hints that dark energy may be weakening, but it is not proven yet. If it stays constant, the universe could drift into a Big Freeze; if it fades enough, a Big Crunch might be possible.

NASA, Building Blocks of the Universe: https://science.nasa.gov/universe/overview/building-blocks/
AP via Phys.org, 2011 Nobel Prize in Physics for the accelerating universe: https://phys.org/news/2011-10-perlmutter-schmidt-riess-nobel-physics.html
Berkeley Lab, New DESI results strengthen hints that dark energy may evolve: https://newscenter.lbl.gov/2025/03/19/new-desi-results-strengthen-hints-that-dark-energy-may-evolve/
BBC Science Focus, Dark energy could be fading: https://www.sciencefocus.com/space/dark-energy-fading-universe
ScienceDaily, Dark energy may have flipped 9.5 billion years ago (Istanbul Technical University): https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261111005901.htm
